messages:
sophia.k: Morning team — noticed my March deposit is $295 less than expected. I relocated from OR to WA on 2026-02-20 and updated address in the HR portal, but my stub shows OR state tax taken. Payrun id PR-2026-03-15-8421. Could someone check sync?

omar.hr: @ben.payroll can you check PR-2026-03-15-8421? Sophia, did you also submit any state withholding change form or just updated the address?

sophia.k: I only updated address and uploaded WA license on 2/21. No new state W-4 since WA has no state income tax.

payroll-bot: PR-2026-03-15-8421: processed 2026-03-15 06:58 UTC. Employee state on payroll record: OR. Federal withholding normal. (auto note)

ben.payroll: Thanks. Looks like HRIS -> payroll sync missed before payroll cutoff. I'll open vendor ticket to request reversal of state withholding and an off-cycle net payment if possible. @tess.finance FYI for GL impact.

tess.finance: If vendor can issue a refund for the withheld state tax we can book a reversing entry and do an off-cycle top-up. If not possible we'll reconcile via a W-2c next year, but prefer immediate fix. Need gross and OR state withheld amounts.

sophia.k: Gross pay was $5,800. OR withheld $295. Attached paystub screenshot to portal.

ben.payroll: Ticket PAY-4520 created with vendor; requesting expedited refund and off-cycle. Also confirming employee status: W-2? union?

sophia.k: W-2, not union.

omar.hr: I uploaded the address change confirmation and WA license image to PAY-4520 and set a block to prevent OR withholding on future runs. :white_check_mark:

payroll-bot: PAY-4520 logged. SLA 72h. Current status: vendor triage. Next update expected 2026-03-18 14:00 UTC.

ben.payroll: Vendor estimated 1-3 business days. If approved we'll schedule an off-cycle deposit of +$295. If vendor declines, fallback is manual reversal in next payroll and accounting adjustment or W-2c. Will update when I hear back.

sophia.k: Appreciate it. Please let me know if you need more docs or bank info.

tess.finance: For accounting: hold code "payroll_miswithhold" for this case until resolved.

ben.payroll: Updated PAY-4520 with bank last4 confirmation from Sophia. Standing by for vendor confirmation.
